build_NLTKTokenizer: build a python module that creates an NLTKTokenizer instance to tokenize text using nltk word_tokenize
run_NLTKTokenizer_encode: run the NLTKTokenizer encode method to split input text into space-separated tokens
run_NLTKTokenizer_decode: run the NLTKTokenizer decode method to return the input string as-is
review_NLTKTokenizer_init: review the NLTKTokenizer constructor that imports nltk word_tokenize and raises ImportError if missing
test_NLTKTokenizer_encode_decode: test the NLTKTokenizer encode and decode methods with sample text input
